messages:
Jamie: Ugh, anyone else seeing wild Wi‑Fi drops with this rain? My calls kept dying. Here's my "battle station" and the router living in the basil pot :sob:
Jamie: <https://files.redwood.internal/jamie/IMG_2026.jpg|IMG_2026.jpg>
Alex: same. ISP says 'degraded service' on their status page. my home mesh has a sad LED.
Maria: try power‑cycling the modem/AP and leave it unplugged 30s. Also check DNS fallback: `ping 1.1.1.1` then `dig +short @1.1.1.1 redwood.com`
Sam: ISP outage map shows a blob near you: <https://downdetector.example/isps/greenwave>
Jamie: unplugged, waiting. plant insisted on being rescued first 🌱
RouterBot: Outage alert: detected 12 dropped pings in 60s from 176.234.0.1
Alex: reboot worked for me earlier. `sudo systemctl restart NetworkManager` (linux)
Maria: if you're on mac: `sudo ifconfig en0 down && sudo ifconfig en0 up` or just toggle Wi‑Fi from menu bar
Jamie: back! stable for 10m. thanks y'all :raised_hands:
Sam: also pro tip — put the router on a small riser so leaks don't kill it. Learned it the hard way :grimacing:
Alex: poll: how many of us have a plant in our WFH setup? :palm_tree:
Maria: me! one cactus. low maintenance
Sam: two — a monstera and an aloe
Jamie: basil and a suspicious pothos
Alex: I have 0, but a very judgemental succulant meme in my wallpaper :joy:
Maria: Post your setups later, let's do a 'best cable management' vote :trophy:
Jamie: ok will post a cleaned pic in an hour. coffee + cable ties incoming ☕️
RouterBot: Reminder: if ISP still flaky, DM infra for suggestions on backup hotspots
Sam: also — anyone tried the new 5G hotspot plan? thoughts?
Alex: got a trial, decent for dev work but expensive for sustained usage
Jamie: thanks folks. crisis averted. back to trying to keep basil alive and PRs merged :seedling: :keyboard:
